title: Read a member's savings (REGULAR SHARES) balance
description: Opens Member Inquiry, searches by a given member number, and returns the current balance of that member's REGULAR SHARES savings account from the member detail account table. Input: member number. Output: savings balance (money). Read-only; performs no account maintenance actions.

member_number.description: Credit union member number to look up

regular_shares_balance.description: Current balance of the member's REGULAR SHARES savings account

outcomes.description: The member number was valid but no member exists.
Operator lacks permission for this record (e.g. employee accounts).
The application rejected a field value (format, minimums, insufficient funds).

member_inquiry_link.rationale: Unique accessible role+name (link 'MEMBER INQUIRY'): survives markup and layout changes and maps to desktop accessibility APIs. Fallbacks, each verified unique at record time: text, css; replay flags any use of a fallback as degradation.

locators.selector: body:nth-of-type(1) > table:nth-of-type(1) > tbody:nth-of-type(1) > tr:nth-of-type(2) > td:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > table:nth-of-type(1) > tbody:nth-of-type(1) > tr:nth-of-type(1) > td:nth-of-type(2) > input:nth-of-type(1)

member_number_input.rationale: No accessible name (table layout, no <label>/aria); identified the way an operator does, by the visible label 'Member Number:' beside it. Fallbacks, each verified unique at record time: css; replay flags any use of a fallback as degradation.

locators.selector: body:nth-of-type(1) > table:nth-of-type(1) > tbody:nth-of-type(1) > tr:nth-of-type(2) > td:nth-of-type(1) > form:nth-of-type(1) > table:nth-of-type(1) > tbody:nth-of-type(1) > tr:nth-of-type(1) > td:nth-of-type(3)

search_clickable.rationale: Non-semantic clickable with no ARIA role; matched by its visible text 'SEARCH'. Fallbacks, each verified unique at record time: css; replay flags any use of a fallback as degradation.

current_balance_value.description: column 'Current Balance' of the row keyed 'REGULAR SHARES'

locators.selector: body:nth-of-type(1) > table:nth-of-type(1) > tbody:nth-of-type(1) > tr:nth-of-type(2) > td:nth-of-type(1) > table:nth-of-type(2) > tbody:nth-of-type(1) > tr:nth-of-type(2) > td:nth-of-type(3)

current_balance_value.rationale: Addressed by row key + column header rather than position, so added or reordered rows do not break it. Row key is the first non-volatile cell (not an amount, date or number). Fallbacks, each verified unique at record time: css; replay flags any use of a fallback as degradation.

steps.intent: Open the Member Inquiry function to look up a member
Enter the member number to search
Read the current balance of the REGULAR SHARES (savings) account
